st: New breath sensors and the best cure for every disease: moving

sec.t: ff.86.1 If you don't move, you die
sec.p: If you move, you lower your probability of dying from any cause over the next ten years.

sec.t: ff.86.2 Measuring the oxygen you burn
sec.p: Health and oxygen consumption go hand in hand. Hence an ecosystem of new sensors, like Calibre.
